verdict.rationale: Elicit's API and MCP server expose search and end-to-end Systematic Review functionality (search, screening, extraction, reporting), giving programmatic access to core research capabilities, but there's no evidence that UI-only features like the interactive Research Agent chat, Skills, real-time collaboration, columns customization, alerts, or the browser extension are exposed via the API/MCP surface. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of full feature parity, API/MCP access to Research Agent conversational sessions, skills, collaboration, and alerts.
